drivetrain.wheel_mass_classification: PROVISIONAL_GAZEBO_INPUT; weigh the real wheel plus hub
drivetrain.motor_source: DFRobot FIT0403, repository purchase record: 38 kg.cm nominal rated/stall label used as a conservative torque ceiling

payload_sweep.assumption: Payload centred; mass is shared equally by the four wheels. Gazebo peaks are not rescaled across payloads.

corner_proximity_sweep.assumption: Conservative turn loads act at one wheel; the printed 90-degree joint is represented by Kt=2.5 until a filleted corner/splice FEM and physical corner coupon exist.

light_test_fixture.description: Expected no-basket, no-traction-battery test fixture; mass and friction are provisional.

conservative_turn.description: High-traction turn-in-place screen with impact/load-transfer allowance; not a measured operating point.

missing_measurements: assembled test-fixture mass and centre of gravity
actual four steel mount hole centres and bolt diameter after gauge confirmation
slicer wall count, infill, layer height and rail print orientation
same-printer coupons for XY and Z strength
measured Gazebo or physical peak joint wrench during turn-in-place
actual motor-centre to 90-degree corner distance after splice/corner CAD
corner fillet radius, sleeve engagement and fastener preload
